name: University College London
typicalOffer: AAA, Biology and Chemistry required, plus Mathematics preferred
notes: 3-year BSc covering human physiology, cell biology and disease; Chemistry or Biology required; strong links to UCL Hospital for clinical exposure

name: King's College London
typicalOffer: AAA, including grade A in Biology and Chemistry
notes: 3-year BSc with strong clinical science and translational research emphasis; Chemistry or Biology required; integrated with Guy's Hospital

name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: AAB, Biology and Chemistry, one at A and one at B; Mathematics or Physics recommended
notes: Scottish 4-year degree; broad biomedical curriculum including molecular biology, physiology and pharmacology; Chemistry or Biology required

name: Imperial College London
typicalOffer: AAA, A in Biology or Human Biology; A in Chemistry, Mathematics, Further Mathematics or Physics; A in another subject
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Manchester
typicalOffer: AAA-AAB, including two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics and Mathematics (the Core Sciences)
notes: 3-year BSc with optional intercalated year; Chemistry or Biology required; part of the Wellcome Trust Centre for Cell-Matrix Research

name: University of Bristol
typicalOffer: AAA, including Chemistry and another core science/mathematics subject (Biology, Further Mathematics, Human Biology, Mathematics or Physics)
notes: 3-year BSc with strong molecular medicine and neuroscience modules; Biology or Chemistry required; optional year in industry

name: University of Sheffield
notes: 3-year BSc spanning genomics, drug discovery and clinical pathology; Biology or Chemistry required; strong links to Sheffield Teaching Hospitals

name: University of Nottingham
typicalOffer: AAB-ABB, including biology/human biology and a second science (chemistry, maths, physics, psychology and others listed)
notes: 3-year BSc with options in cancer biology, neuroscience and infection; Biology or Chemistry required; access to dedicated biomedical research building

name: University of Southampton
typicalOffer: ABB, including Biology or Chemistry and one further science subject
notes: 3-year BSc with strong translational medicine focus; Biology or Chemistry required; close links to Southampton General Hospital and the Wellcome Trust Centre

name: Newcastle University
typicalOffer: AAB, including Biology or Chemistry, plus at least one from Mathematics or Further Mathematics, Physics, Psychology, Biology or Chemistry
notes: 3-year BSc with specialisms in ageing, immunity and neuroscience; Biology or Chemistry required; linked to Institute of Neuroscience and Newcastle Hospitals NHS

name: University of Birmingham
typicalOffer: AAB, two science A levels: one from Biology or Chemistry plus another from Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics or Psychology
notes: 3-year BSc with optional intercalated year; Biology required; strong cancer biology and cardiovascular research programmes at University Hospitals Birmingham

name: University of Leeds
typicalOffer: AAB, including Biology or Chemistry, plus another science or science-related subject
notes: 3-year BSc with emphasis on translational biomedical research; Biology or Chemistry required; optional placement year in NHS laboratory

name: Cardiff University
typicalOffer: AAB-ABB, Must include Biology or Chemistry; pass the science practical element
notes: 3-year BSc with modules in molecular medicine, immunology and pharmacology; Biology required; linked to Cardiff NHS Trust and the Neuroscience and Mental Health Research Institute

name: University of Glasgow
typicalOffer: AAB, A-level Biology or Chemistry at grade A
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: Queen Mary University of London
typicalOffer: AAB, including Biology plus a second science from Chemistry, Maths, Further Maths, Physics or Psychology
notes: 3-year BSc based in Barts and The London School of Medicine; Biology or Chemistry required; exceptional clinical exposure in East London NHS Trusts

name: University of Bath
typicalOffer: AAA or A*AB, including A in Biology and A in Chemistry
notes: 3-year BSc with optional placement year in industry or hospital laboratory; Biology or Chemistry required; strong pharmaceutical and drug delivery research links

name: University of Leicester
typicalOffer: BBB, including at least two relevant science subjects from Biology, Chemistry, Maths, Physics or Psychology; General Studies not accepted
notes: 3-year BSc with strong genetics and molecular medicine modules; Biology required; linked to Leicester Royal Infirmary; DNA fingerprinting heritage

name: University of Sussex
notes: 3-year BSc with options in neuroscience and global health; Biology required; close proximity to Brighton's medical community and Sussex NHS Trust
